description: Weekly tuning for the bio page. Once a week the server moves up to max_moves links that beat their spot above ones that trail, each only when the numbers are 90% sure (the same moves bio_suggest offers). Only reorders: it never hides, renames or features a link, never moves a pinned link, and leaves visitors alone while a test runs on them. Leave sources out to tune the main page from every visitor's numbers, or list apps to tune each one's own order (bio_variant_set) from its own visitors. Each move is its own Activity row with Undo and sends a note. Undo here puts the last setting back.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

max_moves.description: Most moves a week on each page it tunes

sources.description: Apps whose own order to tune; leave out for the main page

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_autopilot_set
title: Tune the link page weekly
